user.title: Golmar / Quvii account
user.description: Sign in with your Golmar G2Call+ or Vimar View Door account (or another Quvii-based intercom app). Credentials are used to fetch each panel's local key; door control afterwards is local unless you choose otherwise below. Pick your brand; the advanced fields below only matter for a custom brand.

data.brand: Brand / app (Golmar G2Call+, Vimar View Door, or custom)
data.app_id: App ID (advanced — only read when brand is custom)
data.oem_id: OEM ID (advanced — only read when brand is custom)
data.server_host: Account server (advanced — only read when brand is custom)
data.unlock_mode: How to open doors: local / auto / cloud

data_description.brand: golmar = Golmar G2Call+. vimar = Vimar View Door (e.g. K42955). custom = another Quvii-based app: fill in App ID, OEM ID and, if the brand has its own server, Account server.
data_description.account: For Vimar leave account and password empty: the next step gets them from Vimar's sign-in page.
data_description.unlock_mode: local = LAN only, fastest and works without internet. cloud = send the open command through the Quvii servers; needed by panels whose firmware only opens the local interface while the app is streaming video. auto = try local first, fall back to cloud.
data_description.extra_hosts: Only needed if a panel is not on Home Assistant's own subnet — for example on a separate VLAN. Discovery scans the local subnet automatically.
data_description.region: Leave this alone. Sign-in finds the regional server that actually holds your account and remembers it, so this only matters as a starting point for that search.
data_description.server_host: Leave empty to search Quvii's regional servers. Set it only for a custom brand that has its own account server, e.g. brand.qvcloud.net.

vimar_sso.title: Vimar View Door sign-in
vimar_sso.description:
Vimar accounts sign in through Vimar's own page, so your vimar.com email and password are not what the intercom cloud accepts.

1. Open [this sign-in page]({url}) in a browser and log in with your View Door / vimar.com account.
2. It ends on a page showing a short text containing "result":0, "account" and "password".
3. Copy all of it and paste it below.

data_description.sso_json: Paste the whole text, braces included. Only the account and password inside it are stored.

select.title: Choose which doors to control
select.description: Tick the panels and locks you actually use — the same ones you open from the official Golmar app. Block entrances appear as "Door N" and street entrances as "General Panel N", each with two lock relays. Only the channels physically wired to your panel open anything; the rest are accepted by the panel but do nothing. You can change this later in the integration's options.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Quvii cloud.
error.no_devices: Login worked but no devices were found on this account.
error.login_refused: No Quvii regional server recognised this account, and the refusal was not about the account or password. The server's own code is in the Home Assistant log — please report it on GitHub, because it means your account is served somewhere this integration does not know about.
error.invalid_sso_json: That is not the text from the Vimar sign-in page. Paste everything it shows, from the first character to the last. If it shows an error, open the link again and sign in once more.

init.title: Doors to control
init.description: Update which panels and locks appear as buttons — match what you open from the official Golmar app. Only channels wired to your panel actually open; untick the rest.
